title.zh: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
title.en: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar

current_state.zh: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launched JQQQ, a tokenized Nasdaq-100 tracking fund on Stellar available to eligible non-US investors, as Janus Henderson's institutional onchain strategies passed $1 billion.
